data.content_ref: inline:SRC_006 contradicts SRC_005 by escalating the same flat-rate error in the opposite direction: SRC_005 undercounts by paying all hours at base ($846), while SRC_006 overcounts by paying all hours at overtime ($1,269), so they share mechanism — a threshold-blind scalar applied to all hours — but differ in which rate is misapplied. Refuted if either artifact's error cannot be characterized as 'omitting the 40-hour boundary and applying a single rate globally,' or if SRC_006 depends on SRC_005 rather than contradicting it.
